scripts.dev:api: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/run-python.ps1 -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir apps/api --reload
scripts.build: npm --prefix packages/contracts run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.lint: npm run lint:ts && npm run lint:api
scripts.lint:ts: npm --prefix packages/contracts run lint && npm --prefix apps/web run lint
scripts.lint:api: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/run-python.ps1 -m ruff check apps/api
scripts.format: npm run format:ts && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/run-python.ps1 -m ruff format apps/api
scripts.format:check: npm run format:ts:check && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/run-python.ps1 -m ruff format --check apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix packages/contracts run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/run-python.ps1 -m mypy apps/api/app
scripts.test: npm --prefix packages/contracts run test && npm --prefix apps/web run test && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/run-python.ps1 -m pytest apps/api/tests
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test
